tool.name: msuvbinner
tool.shortdescription: Create a gridded/and or bin onto a measurementset from a set of measurementsets

param.name: phasecenter
param.description: phasecenter of the output ms (no default)

param.name: nx
param.description: number of pixel along U axis

param.name: ny
param.description: number of pixel along U axis

param.name: ncorr
param.description: number of correlations per visibility point (can only be 1, 2, or 4)

param.name: nchan
param.description: number of channel along spectral axis

param.name: cellx
param.description: image domain size of pixel along x-direction

param.name: celly
param.description: image domain size of pixel along y-direction

param.name: fstart
param.description: frequency of first spectral channel in the LSRK frame

param.name: fstep
param.description: frequency width of channels

param.name: memfrac
param.description: frequency width of channels

param.name: wproject
param.description: correct for w term using w-projection algorithm while gridding

param.name: doflag
param.description: transfer flag from gridded visibility data back to input ms

method.name: selectdata
method.shortdescription: select the data from input ms that will go on the gridded vis

param.name: msname
param.description: Path to the MS to import

param.name: spw
param.description: Spectral window selection (using MSSelection syntax)

param.name: field
param.description: field selection

param.name: baseline
param.description: baselines selection (using MSSelection syntax)

param.name: scan
param.description: Scan selection

param.name: uvrange
param.description: uvrange

param.name: taql
param.description: Generic TaQL selection

method.name: setoutputms
method.shortdescription: define gridded visibilities output; either existing grid or a new one will be made
method.description: Where gridded visibilities will be stored; either an already existant ms or a new one will be made. If a file of the name exist and the input parameters match then new gridded data will be added to the existing one; this is the way to add data of multiple epochs on the same grid.

param.name: outms
param.description: Output ms name

method.name: filloutputms
method.shortdescription: launch gridding process from selected input to set output
method.description: launch gridding process from selected input to set output
method.example: from casatools import msuvbinner ##define the output grid parameters, like phasecenter and number of channels msbinner=msuvbinner(phasecenter="J2000 19h30m20.9 -19d50m22.7", nx=2000, ny=2000, ncorr=1, nchan=16, cellx='10arcsec', celly='10arcsec', fstart='975MHz', fstep='50kHz', memfrac=0.9, wproject=False, doflag=False) #select the data; note taql usage to avoid a baseline band where -10m \> V \< 10m msbinner.selectdata(msname='myinput1.ms', spw='0', field='0', taql='UVW[1] \> 10 or UVW[1] \< -10') #define the name of the output grid msbinner.setoutputms('myuvgrid.ms') ## grid the input data to the output grid msbinner.filloutputms() ##select a second input visibilities msbinner.selectdata(msname='myinput2.ms', spw='0', field='0', taql='') ##add it to the previously defined output grid msbinner.filloutputms() del msbinner
